verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 35.138
verses.english: Linked Discourses 35.138

verses.pali: 14. Devadahavagga
verses.english: 14. At Devadaha

verses.pali: Paṭhamanatumhākasutta
verses.english: Not Yours (1st)

verses.pali: “Yaṁ, bhikkhave, na tumhākaṁ taṁ pajahatha.
verses.english: “Mendicants, give up what’s not yours.

verses.pali: Taṁ vo pahīnaṁ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
verses.english: Giving it up will be for your welfare and happiness.

verses.pali: Kiñca, bhikkhave, na tumhākaṁ?
verses.english: And what isn’t yours?

verses.pali: Cakkhu, bhikkhave, na tumhākaṁ; taṁ pajahatha.
verses.english: The eye isn’t yours: give it up.

verses.pali: Taṁ vo pahīnaṁ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati …pe…
verses.english: Giving it up will be for your welfare and happiness.

verses.pali: jivhā na tumhākaṁ; taṁ pajahatha.
verses.english: The ear … nose … tongue … body …

verses.pali: Sā vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissati …pe…
mano na tumhākaṁ; taṁ pajahatha.
verses.english: mind isn’t yours: give it up.

verses.pali: So vo pahīno hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
verses.english: Giving it up will be for your welfare and happiness.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, yaṁ imasmiṁ jetavane tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṁ taṁ jano hareyya vā ḍaheyya vā yathāpaccayaṁ vā kareyya, api nu tumhākaṁ evamassa:
verses.english: Suppose a person was to carry off the grass, sticks, branches, and leaves in this Jeta’s Grove, or burn them, or do what they want with them. Would you think:

verses.pali: ‘amhe jano harati vā ḍahati vā yathāpaccayaṁ vā karotī’”ti?
verses.english: ‘This person is carrying us off, burning us, or doing what they want with us’?”

verses.pali: “No hetaṁ, bhante”.
verses.english: “No, sir.

verses.pali: “Taṁ kissa hetu”?
verses.english: Why is that?

verses.pali: “Na hi no etaṁ, bhante, attā vā attaniyaṁ vā”ti.
verses.english: Because  to us that’s neither self nor belonging to self.”

verses.pali: “Evameva kho, bhikkhave, cakkhu na tumhākaṁ; taṁ pajahatha.
verses.english: “In the same way, the eye isn’t yours: give it up.

verses.pali: Taṁ vo pahīnaṁ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati …pe…
verses.english: Giving it up will be for your welfare and happiness.

verses.pali: jivhā na tumhākaṁ; taṁ pajahatha.
verses.english: The ear … nose … tongue … body …

verses.pali: Sā vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissati …pe…
mano na tumhākaṁ; taṁ pajahatha.
verses.english: mind isn’t yours: give it up.

verses.pali: So vo pahīno hitāya sukhāya bhavissatī”ti.
verses.english: Giving it up will be for your welfare and happiness.”

verses.pali: Pañcamaṁ.
